title: ORSMT: Unleashing the Potential of Satisfiability Modulo Theories for Semantic Verification and Repair in LLM-Based Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29145v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models increasingly automate optimization modeling from natural language problems, producing written mathematics, solver code and a returned report. Verifying one optimization problem across these artifacts requires semantic comparison: unequal models can attain the same objective, equivalent models can use different auxiliary variables, and mutually consistent artifacts can omit the same source requirement. ORSMT provides a typed semantic interface and exact SMT relation queries. It aligns observable decisions, projects auxiliary variables, proves or refutes feasible region and objective relations, localizes refutations to implicated rows or domains and links source texts when available. It then reconstructs one artifact from another, and each adopted candidate passes the required relation checks. translated_title: ORSMT：在基于大语言模型的优化中释放可满足性模理论在语义验证与修复方面的潜力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正越来越多地实现从自然语言问题到优化建模的自动化，产出书面的数学模型、求解器代码以及返回的报告。跨这些产物验证同一个优化问题需要语义层面的比较：不相等的模型可能达到相同的目标值，等价的模型可能使用不同的辅助变量，而彼此一致的产物可能共同遗漏了源需求。ORSMT 提供了一个类型化的语义接口和精确的 SMT 关系查询。它对齐可观测的决策变量，投影辅助变量，证明或反驳可行域与目标之间的关系，将反驳定位到所涉及的行或定义域，并在可用时链接源文本。随后，它从另一个产物重构出目标产物，且每个被采纳的候选都必须通过所需的关系检查。在 3,034 个问题和六种生成器规模上，ORSMT 在全部 72 种基准与生成器组合中都提升了模型与代码的匹配率。
tldr: ORSMT 利用可满足性模理论（SMT）对大语言模型生成的优化产物（数学模型、求解器代码等）进行精确的语义关系验证，并通过产物间的重构实现自动修复，显著提升了模型与代码的语义匹配率。
en_tdlr: ORSMT leverages Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) to perform exact semantic relation verification across LLM-generated optimization artifacts and achieves automatic repair through artifact reconstruction, substantially improving model-code semantic match rates.
